title: FinancialML CreditDefaultSPR

stats.done_summary: Completed the research task. Explored various feature engineering techniques (n-grams, positional features, HMMs, string kernels) and models (Logistic Regression, XGBoost, Random Forest, CNN, LSTM). The final model is a Logistic Regression with L1 penalty using character n-grams (1-4) and one-hot encoded positional features. Generated ROC curve and feature importance plots. Wrote the final report in report/report.md.
